scope: Spotlight/featured hero media for the featured entries in dist/games.json. Files owned here: dist/assets/spotlight-v2/*, dist/spotlight-media.json, this receipt, plus optional contact artefacts. No change to catalogue, app.js, hero/discovery/CSS, Git, Trello or Sites.
method: Official publisher / Steam store API media only (Steam store appdetails screenshots, Steam library_hero art, GOG store key art, EA publisher asset CDN). Each candidate is fetched from its publisher/store CDN, validated (HTTP status, JPEG magic bytes, SOF header dimensions, byte count, sha256) and then reduced to 96x54 RGB with ffmpeg for computational composition analysis. The background-position value is derived from that pixel data. Nothing is generated, upscaled or re-encoded from a lower-resolution source: every file is the publisher CDN bytes as-is.

compositionMethod: For each replacement, a 96x54 RGB sample (ffmpeg scale → rawvideo rgb24) gives mean absolute neighbour difference per horizontal third and mean luminance per half. The hero renders full-bleed with background-size:cover under a dark left-to-right gradient, so a centre-dominant source gets x=center and a right-heavy one x=65; y stays in the familiar 32-44% band. This is a pixel-statistic heuristic, not a visual judgement.
